text_block_list.text:
When I came to the cafeteria, I spotted 
Manhattan Cafe together with Yukino Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Cafe-san's Trainer! Helloooo~
choice_data_list: Hello. What were you two doing?
Hello. What were you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to make a customized drink for 
Yukino-san right now...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san was reading a cafe feature in 
her room, and it seemed like she was 
curious about the drink in it, so...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering what it tasted like, 
and then Cafe-san asked me, "Would you 
like to try some?"!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Everything featured in here... was well 
within what even I could make, so...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Bein' able to make fancy cafe drinks like 
that is crazy impressive! It's so 
city-slicker cool~!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...The taste might not compare to a 
proper restaurant, but I believe you'll 
find the atmosphere quite enjoyable."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“...So, Yukino-san, which one would you 
like to try?”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
About that... there's so many kinds and 
they all look so yummy, so I'm torn... I 
haven't been able to pick yet~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, let's see! Which one should I go 
with...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, that's right! What kind of person do 
you think would be good as Cafe's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't decide at all... If you don't 
mind, could you tell me what you 
recommend?
choice_data_list:
Something with a long, deep lingering 
aftertaste.
Something refreshing and easy to drink

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, it feels kinda grown-up... But I 
sure wanna try drinkin' somethin' like 
that too!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Taking that direction, if we're looking 
for something that would be easy for 
Yukino-san to drink—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
――Thank you for waiting. Here is your 'Hot 
Buttered Au Lait.'

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa— It smells super sweet and amazin'! 
Is this really coffee!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The source of the aroma is cinnamon. 
Combined with the richness of the 
butter... it steeps you in its fragrance 
right to your core...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm~! So goood~! It's warmin' me right 
up, makes me feel so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Cafe-san, thank you so very much! I'll 
never forget this taste for the rest of my 
life!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, you exaggerate... Still—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......Please let me know anytime again.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you take an interest in coffee... 
makes me happy, too...

Seeing Manhattan Cafe's smile, I felt a 
warmth that rivaled even a cup of hot 
buttered au lait.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, that looks like somethin' even I 
could drink...! Cafe-san, I wanna try 
drinkin' that!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Understood. If it's that sort of flavor—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
――Thank you for waiting. Here is your 
'Citrus Iced Coffee Tonic.'

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh— Th-This is coffee!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's fizzy, with oranges floating in it... 
Looks just like some fancy juice!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It certainly looks like carbonated juice 
at first glance, but... it is a proper 
specialty coffee creation.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When the carbonation of the tonic water 
blends with the orange flavor... it brings 
a crisp freshness reminiscent of a summer 
sky...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm~! So goood! It goes down so smooth 
and easy to drink!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Plus somehow, it's sweet but also 
bitter... I-It's such a grown-up taste~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Cafe-san! Thank you so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm just so moved gettin' to fully enjoy 
feelin' like a stylish "City Girl"!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. If so, then I am glad. Please 
feel free to let me know anytime.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you take an interest in coffee... 
makes me happy, too...

Seeing Manhattan Cafe's smile, I felt a 
refreshing gentleness, as if a citrus 
aroma lingered in the air.
